summary: The internal vars cache will be removed in 2.24 in favor of the vars and varnames lookups, and include_vars ignore_files given as a string is deprecated in favor of a list.
questions: Is the vars variable being removed in Ansible?
How should I pass ignore_files to include_vars?
What should I use instead of vars[...] to look up a variable by name?

answer_card.title: vars cache and include_vars ignore_files string
answer_card.answer_md:
- The internal **`vars`** variable cache will be removed in 2.24, since it exposes variables in inconsistent states. Use the `vars` and `varnames` lookups instead.
- `include_vars` `ignore_files` as a string is deprecated; pass a list:

```yaml
- include_vars:
    dir: vars/
    ignore_files: [".gitkeep"]
```
